description: Free, unsigned and stored nowhere: the same question as recta_evaluate with the same arguments, answered only with whether a cheaper provable route exists, the saving (lower bound, USDC) and Recta's 5 % of it. Names no route and returns no result_id; 3 a day per IP address. Use it to see whether Recta is worth a signature. Works without a key (give sender, or set RECTA_ADDRESS).

amount.description: How much of source_asset to send, in whole tokens (not cents, not wei): "100" with USDC means 100 USDC. Minimum 3.5 for stablecoins (about 3.5 USD). Recta sets no maximum; this server refuses more than the operator's limit (RECTA_MAX_AMOUNT, default 1000).

baseline_provider.description: The route you would use without Recta, one of the corridor's declarable_baselines in recta_fit (GET /v1/golden-corridor/fit): across, stargate_v2, usdt0, usdg_oft, debridge_dln or lifi (LI.FI: declarable where recta_fit lists lifi in declarable_baselines, never with latency_class SECONDS or MINUTES; Recta reads LI.FI's own transaction, fee included). The saving is measured against it. Relay is compared but cannot be declared, and CCTP needs a destination execution authority this tool does not send.

recipient.description: Destination address; defaults to the local wallet. Any other address must be on the operator's list (RECTA_ALLOWED_RECIPIENTS), or the evaluation is refused before anything is signed.

sender.description: Only when the server runs without a key: the EVM address the transfer would leave from (0x + 40 hex), else RECTA_ADDRESS. With a key it is ignored: the sender is the local wallet.

source_asset.description: Asset moved, e.g. USDC or USDT.

source_network.description: Source network key, e.g. base, arbitrum, ethereum, optimism, polygon.

name: recta_trial_evaluation
